Picture: Aase sits bolt upright in the middle of the dusty road beside the Goose Meadow, sewing patch on patch in her lap, and looks straight out at the viewer with a calm, knowing little smile. A flock of white and grey geese mills behind her. Far away down the road, a rider in a scarlet cloak on a tall bay horse is coming, with two more riders behind him.

- Aase: A small, sturdy young woman of about eighteen, a head shorter than most, with a round, sun-browned face, a small determined chin, a snub nose, calm dark-brown eyes that look straight at you and thick, straight eyebrows. characters.name: Aase the Goose-girl
characters.description: A patched, steadfast goose-herd who calmly insists she is meant to marry the English prince and is ultimately proven right.
characters.look: A small, sturdy young woman of about eighteen, a head shorter than most, with a round, sun-browned face, a small determined chin, a snub nose, calm dark-brown eyes that look straight at you and thick, straight eyebrows. Her thick dark-brown hair is in one short, stubby plait tied with red wool. She wears a plain brown wool dress mended with patch on patch of blue and green, a white apron, wooden clogs and a little patchwork sewing bag at her waist.

characters.name: The King’s Son from England
characters.description: A traveling English prince seeking a pure bride, wary of deception, who uses a knowing stone and a hidden ring to uncover the truth.
characters.look: A tall, lean prince of about twenty-four with a long, kind face, a slightly long straight nose, calm hazel eyes, neat sandy hair parted at the side and a small, neatly trimmed sandy moustache, with a polite, patient smile. He wears a thin gold circlet, a scarlet wool tunic with gold braid across the chest, a long scarlet riding cloak, cream hose and brown riding boots with turned-down cuffs.

characters.name: The Knowing Stone
characters.description: A mysterious stone placed before the prince’s bed that reveals the truth about whoever steps in or out.
characters.look: A small, smooth, egg-shaped stone no bigger than a plum, polished like a river pebble, milky white with faint swirls of pale gold and rose inside. It has no face and never moves, but when it speaks, or someone steps over it, it glows with a soft, warm golden light that spreads around it like candlelight.

characters.name: The Third Princess
characters.description: The last of the three princesses, every bit as sly as the other two, who whispers to Aase to take her place and is exposed by the stone.
characters.look: A tall, willowy princess of about twenty with a long neck, a narrow face, high arched brows over big, anxious dark-brown eyes, a delicate little mouth and glossy chocolate-brown hair in long, bouncy ringlets tied back with a pearl-studded ribbon. She wears a thin circlet of pearls, pearl earrings and a long peacock-blue gown with full sleeves and a lace collar, and carries a white feather fan that she likes to hide behind.

places.name: the Goose Meadow
places.look: A wide, gently sloping green meadow full of golden dandelions, with a dusty country road running along its lower edge between grassy ditches, a few young birches in bright new leaf and a low grey stone wall. In the background stands the royal manor, a cluster of big, dark timber buildings with carved balconies and turf roofs.

places.name: the Bedchamber
